column1: # offline-apps.tsv — bring-your-own-app standard (single source of truth).
# Apps you supply yourself as disk images / archives (no Homebrew cask, or a licensed
# build you already own), staged to the target's Desktop with a bilingual HTML guide;
# the human installs them (see scripts/stage-offline-apps.sh).
# These are NOT auto-installed: disk-image layouts vary (app vs nested dmg/pkg vs an
# installer) and Gatekeeper needs a human — staging + a guide is the reliable path.
# Point MACOS_SETUP_LOCAL_PKGS (or MACOS_SETUP_PKG_SSH) at the folder holding YOUR files.
# Replace the example rows below with the apps you supply; filename must match yours.
# Columns (TAB-separated, 10): filename  app  version  cat_zh  cat_en  desc_zh  desc_en  notes_zh  notes_en  icon
# icon = Lucide line-icon name, rendered inline by the staging script.
# General install steps live in the HTML guide; notes_* hold only app-specific tips.
CleanShot_X_4.8.8.iso
column6: 替代系统截图的全能工具——滚动截图、标注、贴图、OCR、录屏录 GIF。

column8: 挂载后将 App 拖入"应用程序"；首次打开走右键→打开。
column9: Mount, drag the app to Applications; first launch via right-click → Open.
